methodology: Every original localHeadline was independently reread on its physical PDF page. Literal extracts preserve source characters and line breaks; tests normalize whitespace only. Source values are converted with Decimal using the printed currency/unit and correct year column. sourcePrecisionPounds records displayed precision, not pounds-level accuracy. Definitions and locators are frozen to this review. All measures remain UNMAPPED to MHCLG RA and excluded from benchmarking. One wrong-year Harrow amount is explicitly withheld; no replacement is inferred. Year/title context is separate where the primary recommendation omits the year. Page hashes cover whitespace-normalized full page text and are tied to the original PDF SHA-256. Normal offline tests check the preserved hash-linked extraction; --verify-headlines --pdf-reader-path re-extracts every cited page directly.
